strategy_summary: Translate the tuples in K_{m,g} into numerical semigroups of multiplicity m via the standard residue-threshold (Kunz/Apéry) correspondence. On the semigroup side, define a child map by deleting the largest minimal generator strictly bigger than the multiplicity. Prove that this deletion raises the genus by exactly 1 and that the deleted generator is recoverable from the child as its smallest special gap above m. This makes the semigroup child map injective, and conjugating it by the tuple-semigroup bijection yields the required injective map Phi_{m,g}.
